page.query: AI consultant vs automation agency cost
page.title: AI consultant vs automation agency cost comparison
page.description: Compare pricing models, deliverables and decision factors for AI consultants and automation agencies to choose the right partner.
page.h1: AI consultant vs automation agency cost
page.definition: AI consultant vs automation agency cost is the comparison of pricing structures and deliverables between independent advisors who assess and plan AI adoption and firms that build and maintain automated workflows. Consultants typically charge day rates or fixed project fees for strategy, while agencies charge build fees plus monthly retainers for implementation and support.
page.quick_answer: Choose a consultant for strategy and tool selection; choose an agency when you need working automations and ongoing support.

sections.h2: What does an AI consultant deliver and how is it priced?

blocks.p: An AI consultant provides an assessment, a prioritised use-case list, a tool choice and a roadmap, typically charged as a day rate or a fixed project fee.

ul: Current state analysis and gap identification
Prioritised use-case shortlist with ROI estimates

sections.h2: What does an automation agency deliver and how is it priced?

blocks.p: An automation agency builds working automations, integrations and documentation, often with a support retainer, priced as a fixed build fee plus a monthly retainer.

sections.h2: How do the pricing models compare side by side?
When should you hire a consultant versus an agency?

blocks.p: Hire a consultant when you need strategy, tool selection and a roadmap; hire an agency when you need working automations and ongoing maintenance.

ul: No clear AI use cases defined → consultant
Internal team lacks build capacity → agency
Need both strategy and build → consider phased approach

sections.h2: What hidden costs should you watch for?

blocks.p: Watch for scope creep, integration complexity, training time and ongoing platform fees that can increase the total investment.

ul: Additional discovery sessions beyond initial scope
Custom connector development for legacy systems
Platform licence upgrades for higher volumes

faq.q: How do I decide between a consultant and an agency for my first AI project?
faq.a: Start with a consultant if you lack a clear use case or tool strategy and need an assessment and roadmap; move to an agency once you have a defined process to automate and need hands-on build, integration and ongoing support.

faq.q: What is the typical cost range for an AI consultant engagement?
faq.a: Consultant engagements usually run on a day rate or fixed project basis, with total cost depending on the depth of assessment, number of use cases evaluated and the length of the roadmap delivered. Expect to invest more for multi-week discovery and stakeholder workshops than for a single-day advisory session.

faq.q: What does an automation agency retainer usually cover?
faq.a: A monthly retainer typically covers monitoring, maintenance, updates to automations, priority support and a set number of change requests, while the initial build fee covers design, development and documentation. Additional hours beyond the retainer are billed separately.

faq.q: Can West Peek Productions help with AI workflow setup?
faq.a: West Peek Productions sets up human-in-the-loop AI workflows for marketing, content and event teams on a scoped engagement basis; it does not operate as a general AI consultancy or automation agency. Send a scope for a quote.

faq.q: What should I include in a request for proposal for AI automation work?
faq.a: Include current process maps, desired outcomes, existing tool stack, data sources, compliance requirements, timeline and budget range so both consultants and agencies can propose relevant solutions. Specify whether you need strategy only or full implementation and support.
